thread:
carla_cs: Heads-up: Socketly renewal is stuck because AP split their PO across two entities (US and UK). They want one SOW + two invoices. Kickoff planned Fri — trying to avoid delay.

mike_ae: Short summary: Renewal agreed for 300 seats, 12m, +6%. Procurement issued PO-US-331 and PO-UK-332. They insist AP can only pay invoices that match their local entity. They also requested Net30.

tanya_fin: We can support split invoicing but need explicit allocation of amounts per PO and vendor codes for both entities. Also need to confirm currency for the UK invoice (GBP) and whether withholding applies.

raj_legal: Legal note: we should have a Billing Split Appendix signed that references the master SOW and maps line items to PO numbers and bill-to entities. I'll draft a 1-paragraph appendix for DocuSign.

onboarding_lee: Operational impact: if signatures slip past Friday morning we lose the provisioning window and licences won't be ready for their training week. Can we start with limited access pending paperwork?

mike_ae: Customer said they can accept provisional access for 5 power users via SSO while paperwork is finalized. Procurement insists no license activation until the PO numbers are on the invoice, though. Tight loop.

tanya_fin: Workable path: 1) sign SOW + Billing Split Appendix; 2) we generate two invoices with agreed split; 3) if customer wants provisional access, we can enable 5 trial seats under a temporary access agreement that expires if PO isn't received in 7 days. But procurement likely rejects temporary access.

raj_legal: I'll add a clause that provisional access requires written procurement acknowledgement; keeps legal protected.

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope SCK-0x4b created. Status: draft. Will attach Billing Split Appendix and SOW. Link: https://docusign.example/envelopes/SCK-0x4b

carla_cs: Customer also asked whether training credits can be applied pro rata across the two invoices or must reside on one invoice. They're flexible but want clarity for internal chargebacks.

tanya_fin: We'll allocate training credits across the two invoices proportionally to seat counts by currency conversion at invoice date. Will document method in appendix. Need approval to account for credits in ARR.

mike_ae: Also asked if payment method can be mixed (ACH for US, wire for UK). Finance, ok?

tanya_fin: Yes — we accept mixed payment methods. We'll include payment instructions per invoice. Note: GBP wire will take 2-3 business days to clear.

onboarding_lee: If we sign the appendix today can I schedule a scaled kickoff (pre-provision sync) so internal SMEs are lined up? I want to avoid the two-week delay.

carla_cs: Customer prefers signing today. Raj/Finance can you finalize wording for the appendix and confirm the invoice split numbers? I'll hold the kickoff slot tentatively.

raj_legal: Drafted Appendix and uploaded to DocuSign. Key points: maps PO-US-331 -> Redwood Inc. (USD) for $180k; PO-UK-332 -> Redwood UK Ltd. (GBP) for £60k; training credits split 75/25; provisional access clause included.

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope SCK-0x4b - status: sent. Recipients: procurement@socketly.com (needs to sign), legal@socketly.co.uk (needs to sign). Expires in 10 days.

tanya_fin: Registered vendor codes: US 1122, UK 7788. We can issue both invoices once signed. I'll prepare payment instructions and mark for recognition split in ARR notes.

mike_ae: Procurement responded: OK to sign appendix now. They requested final invoice amounts be shown in both local currencies and an English summary in USD for internal reporting.

raj_legal: Added an invoice summary table in the appendix (USD + local currencies). Sent updated envelope.

onboarding_lee: Scheduling a scaled kickoff for Fri 9am (internal-only) and will move to customer-facing once invoices process. Marking tasks for provisioning team to be on standby.

carla_cs: Actions: @mike_ae confirm with procurement to sign; @raj_legal finalize doc and attach; @tanya_fin prepare two invoices and payment rails post-signature; @onboarding_lee hold scaled kickoff. I'll update the customer in 30m.

mike_ae: Procurement signed. Sent confirmation email with PO PDFs attached.

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope SCK-0x4b - status: completed. Signed by procurement@socketly.com and legal@socketly.co.uk.

tanya_fin: Invoices generated: Inv-2026-US1122 (USD $180,000) and Inv-2026-UK7788 (GBP £60,000). Sent to AP with payment instructions.

onboarding_lee: Provisioning queued. We'll activate 5 provisional seats upon confirmation of email from AP acknowledging the invoices.

carla_cs: Thanks team. We'll monitor payment receipts; once settled we'll fully provision and roll training credits as agreed. Closing thread when provisioning completes. :tada:

(ends)
